title: Fidelity preview input
description: Render an Object Catalog manifest through one of the non-production HTML fidelity emitters (boxes-arrows, wireframe, review, branded-mockup). Server resolves the fixture name to a vetted file on disk; no caller-supplied paths.

fidelityKind.description: Which HTML fidelity emitter to invoke.

fixture.description: Named server-resident Object Catalog fixture. Allow-listed at the handler — unknown names return OODS-FP-001.

variant.description: Projection-variant selector passed through to the emitter (see s100-m03 selectVariant() / runPreEmit()).

brandOverlay.description: Brand overlay name for the branded-mockup fidelity. Ignored by other fidelities. Unknown names emit OODS-BM-002 and fall back to brand-a per s102-m02.

reviewThreshold.description: Threshold below which entities are flagged for review. Default 0.7. Ignored by non-review fidelities.

includeStyles.description: Inline <style> block toggle. Default true; set false to receive markup without CSS.
